purpose: Recover from supine under the real shared collision constraints without head/foot trapping; retain prone recovery and source interfaces

shared_adaptation.normalizer: import and freeze official denominator semantics
shared_adaptation.critic: Fresh local finite-horizon value network with remaining-time input; positive common reward scaling; no official critic/optimizer history

proposed_value_bootstrap.return_definition: Complete discounted8s Monte Carlo return, gamma0.99, terminal value0; no timeout bootstrap or reset within episode
proposed_value_bootstrap.common_reward_scale: Train-world RMS of complete discounted returns; fixed positive factor for subsequent matched arms
proposed_value_bootstrap.validation: All64heldout development worlds; no normalizer, scale or optimizer fit on them; explained variance and normalized error gate frozen before collection

proposed_actor_pair.control: Common full-contact plant and original getup rewards
proposed_actor_pair.candidate: Only add a late head-versus-feet/hip-yaw contact penalty
proposed_actor_pair.proposed_gate: After2s freeze, both feet contacting and true torso tilt below45degrees; penalize head-leg self contact, not legitimate head-floor support
proposed_actor_pair.matched_initial_state: Same locally bootstrapped critic, imported actor, normalization, optimizer initialization, physical reset and RNG; same sensor computation in both arms
proposed_actor_pair.raw_action_drift: Record drift and KL. Do not equate a needed head-target change with gait failure; use phase-specific actual limits, stability and contacts.
proposed_actor_pair.policy_sample_mask: episode age before action>=2s; exclude overridden sampled actions from actor loss and advantage normalization, retain value loss
proposed_actor_pair.finite_horizon_returns: gamma0.99 lambda0.95, genuine8s terminal value0, never bootstrap from reset observation
proposed_actor_pair.common_normalizers: Freeze imported actor and fitted critic normalizers for both arms

proposed_fixed_evaluation.criteria: Unchanged source recovery by8s then3s stable hold; retain wrong-release failures
proposed_fixed_evaluation.continue_condition: Candidate supine>=31/32, at least2more successes than control, prone>=31/32; jointly inspect head-leg trapping, physical joint limits and all failures. This is a pilot, not final confirmation.

remaining_before_freeze: Integrate and audit finite GAE, active-policy-only actor loss and common fixed statistics in the real learner
Freeze actor/critic optimizers, exploration treatment, budgets, episode-aware degradation tripwire and full saving
Verify matched initial weights, optimizers, physical/IMU/RNG state and actual actor-loss mask before policy updates
Freeze original/control/candidate independent development evaluations and source/export contracts
Use ActionVideo for complete8s getup episodes and verify terminal capture before auto-reset; no3second crop
